scope: Explicit scaling mode: focused local checks, completed GNU/Cray release builds and both compiler scientific scaling cases, including verified regular-server Torc lifecycle for Cray. Source freeze precedes this report.

source.post_freeze_documentation: Later maintained Torc server guide/template promotion and acceptance-ledger updates changed only working documentation; ff4 source and archive bytes were not changed.

mode_contract.cli: sparse_capacity --scaling OUTPUT N REPETITIONS MANAGED_RANK_BYTES MANAGED_NODE_BYTES NODES RANKS_PER_NODE THREADS STACK_BYTES
mode_contract.modeled_rank_envelope: measured baseline address space + managed rank bytes + (requested threads - 1) * stack bytes per worker
mode_contract.modeled_node_rank_envelope: Sum of actual co-located rank envelopes; not an enforced node cap or observed node peak

local_checks.scope: Focused example checks and two MPI ranks on one host; no multi-host or performance claim
local_checks.build_profile: dev/test, debug=0, incremental=0, reused GNU Cargo target
local_checks.runtime_deadline: Local manual GNU timeout: TERM after 120 seconds, KILL grace 5 seconds. This is not the maintained Cirrus launcher.

open_acceptance: Whole-node small aggregate memory enforcement unsupported in this documented Cirrus workflow
Whole-node peak memory and HugeTLB coverage unmeasured
NFS server/worker-WAL durability and reliability unvalidated
Requested OpenMP thread count does not measure each kernel team
Known-rank process sampling excludes other node residents
No speedup claim; fixed-work execution and load times increased with nodes
No overall portable-native acceptance or capacity closure

lifecycle.compute_record_end_time_scope: Planned allocation deadline, not actual completion; actual completion uses Slurm accounting and result completion_time

communication.scope: Application-reported payload counts and coordination calls; MPI-internal traffic and persistence/load wire bytes are unmeasured. Send and receive totals are separate, not added as unique payload.

memory.scope: Rank-process high-water counters and sampled simultaneous sums of known MPI rank PIDs only. Samples may miss instantaneous peaks; launcher, coordinator, filesystem cache, unrelated node residents and HugeTLB coverage are not measured.

metrics.timing_scope: Maximum of rank-local elapsed stage times; stage barriers are included where the fixture measures them. Independent node-local samples are not summed into a simultaneous multi-node peak.
